notes: Restaurant's own Clover COLO2 storefront (linked from elcomalsd.com), address-confirmed 3946 Illinois Street. Markup test: every price is a whole or half dollar (.00 or .50 only across all 133), no divisor produced a meaningful cluster — clean.

notes: Restaurant's own WordPress/Elementor site (Jet Price List widget), address-confirmed 1106 First St., Coronado (matches work-list '1106 1st St'). Sections: Breakfast (Breakfast, All Day), Lunch (Salads, Sandwiches), Dinner, and Special Orders (advance-order whole cakes/tortes/quiche). Two Dinner items (Fresh Seafood of the Day, Chicken of the Day) show only a bare '$' with no number and were dropped per the no-price rule. Special Orders items list 2-3 sizes as slash-separated whole-dollar numbers (e.g. '44/54/64'); every item's description states the corresponding sizes explicitly (e.g. 'Available in sizes 6"/8"/10"'), so each size was split into its own dish row with the size in the name - all values read directly from the source, none derived or averaged. Wine and Beverages sections carry only descriptive text with no per-item prices anywhere on the page (confirmed genuinely unpriced, not a missed read) and were excluded; 'Daily Specials' is a one-line seasonal disclaimer with no items. Markup test: 56 of 64 prices are whole dollars, rest end .25/.50 - clean, no fee pattern.
